task.title: Migrate unassigned-mail component styles while preserving the closed feature gate
task.input: Existing UnassignedInbox/UnassignedNav and shared mail.css; source proves UNASSIGNED_MAIL_LIVE=false and missing backend endpoints.
task.output: Locked visual values in existing components plus actual closed-gate/zero-request evidence; no feature activation.
task.accept: 1) Preserve UNASSIGNED_MAIL_LIVE=false and MAIL_ATTACHMENTS_LIVE=false. In an actual authenticated ADMIN browser, existing inquiry navigation renders no Unassigned mail link; direct /admin/mail/unassigned returns 404, and network logs contain no unassigned/assign-lookup/assign/ignore/attachment calls. Add no backend and do not use sample data as a real inbox. 2) Replace dedicated hard-coded palettes, 8/12/999px radii and 1px borders in existing components/selectors using only section 11 minimalist-flat values. Retain callbacks and their existing states without enabling unavailable actions. Mark isolated component-state assertions as component evidence. 3) At 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 390x844 record a real-service GIF of existing navigation and gated direct access, plus zero-request assertions. For components not rendered because of the gate, computed style/D1-D6/overflow are explicitly gate-off/not-rendered, never pass. Reuse T21 actual visible shared-mail-control density/GIF evidence and verify component states with 2px borders, zero radius, one accent and 44px targets; read 07/11/12, do not open the gate to manufacture evidence. E-107.
